verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a unified `.forget` deletion command that works at three levels: a single data item, an entire dataset including its graph and vector data, or all memory for the current user. Running entirely on your own machine or stack also leaves stored data under the user's control. missing for 10: configurable retention policies or TTL/automatic expiry (including for session memory), documentation of deletion guarantees across all stores, and independent or hands-on corroboration that deletion works as claimed.
